top_changes.old_quote: Climate Change In the area of environmental sustainability, we work to address our climate impacts across our product lifecycle and assess related risks, including current and emerging regulations and market impacts.
top_changes.new_quote: Human Capital Management As of the end of fiscal year 2026, we had approximately 42,000 employees in 38 countries; 31,000 were engaged in research and development and 11,000 were engaged in sales, marketing, operations, and administrative positions.
We also utilize employee listening systems to gather feedback and maintain an inclusive culture where hiring and promotions are based on merit.
Our employees also help to surface top talent, with over 40 percent of our new hires in fiscal year 2026 coming from employee referrals.

top_changes.old_quote: We constantly upgrade our learning offerings to ensure that our employees are exposed to the most current content and technologies available.
top_changes.new_quote: We invest in employee development through on-the-job trainings and tuition reimbursement programs.

top_changes.old_quote: To want NVIDIA to be a place where people can grow their careers over their lifetime and our employees tend to come and stay.
top_changes.new_quote: In fiscal year 2026, our turnover rate was 3.7 percent.

summary: 5 material change(s) in Item 1A between 2025-02-26 and 2026-02-25.

changes.old_quote: Long manufacturing lead times and uncertain supply and capacity availability, combined with a failure to estimate customer demand accurately, has led and could in the future lead to mismatches between supply and demand.
changes.new_quote: Long manufacturing lead times and uncertain supply and capacity availability, combined with a failure to estimate customer demand accurately, has led and could in the future lead to mismatches between supply and demand. We have previously experienced and may continue to experience extended lead times of more than 12 months.
changes.summary: Language strengthened — added 'We have previously experienced and may continue to experience extended lead times of more than 12 months.'

changes.old_quote: If we inaccurately estimate demand, or our customers change orders, as we have experienced in the past, we may not be able to reduce our supply commitments in time, at the same rate, or at all.
changes.new_quote: If we inaccurately estimate demand, or our customers change orders, as we have experienced in the past, we may not be able to reduce our supply commitments in time, at the same rate, or at all. Significant mismatches between supply and demand have varied across our market platforms, resulted in both product shortages and excess inventory, significantly harmed our financial results and could reoccur.
changes.summary: Language strengthened — added 'Significant mismatches between supply and demand have varied across our market platforms, resulted in both product shortages and excess inventory, significantly harmed our financial results and could reoccur.'

changes.old_quote: If we overestimate demand, or if customers cancel or defer orders or choose to purchase from our competitors, we may not be able to utilize on-hand inventory or reduce purchase commitments accordingly.
changes.new_quote: If we overestimate demand, or if customers cancel or defer orders or choose to purchase from our competitors, we may not be able to utilize on-hand inventory or reduce purchase commitments accordingly. The impact of these risks would be amplified by our non-cancellable and non-returnable purchase orders placed in advance of our historical lead times and could be exacerbated if we need to make changes to the design of future products.
changes.summary: Language strengthened — added 'The impact of these risks would be amplified by our non-cancellable and non-returnable purchase orders placed in advance of our historical lead times and could be exacerbated if we need to make changes to the design of future products.'

changes.risk_title: Availability of Data Centers, Energy, and Capital
changes.new_quote: The availability of data centers, energy, and capital to support the buildout of NVIDIA AI infrastructure by our customers and partners is crucial, and any shortage of these and other necessary resources could impact our future revenue and financial performance.
changes.summary: New risk — availability of data centers, energy, and capital is crucial for NVIDIA AI infrastructure buildout.

changes.new_quote: Factors that have caused and/or could in the future cause us to underestimate or overestimate demand, and impact the timing and volume of our revenue, include: changes in product development cycles and time to market; competing technologies and competitor product releases, announcements or other actions; changes in business and economic conditions; sudden or sustained government lockdowns or public health issues; rapidly changing technology or customer requirements; the availability of sufficient data center capacity or energy for customers to procure; new product introductions and transitions resulting in less demand for existing products; new or unexpected end-use cases; increase in demand for competitive products; changes in end-user demand; purchasing decisions made, and inventory levels held by, distributors, ODMs, OEMs, system integrators, other channel partners and other third parties; the ability of developers, end customers and other third parties to build, enhance, and maintain accelerated computing applications that leverage our platforms; the demand for accelerated computing, AI-related cloud services, or large language models; changes that impact the ecosystem for the architectures underlying our products and technologies; government actions or changes in governmental policies, such as export controls, increased restrictions on gaming usage, or tariffs; our customers and partners ability to secure capital and energy and to build complex data center infrastructure timely; and the availability of third-party content on our platforms, such as GeForce NOW.
changes.summary: New risk — challenges in estimating demand due to various factors.

changes.old_quote: Our target markets remain competitive, and competition may intensify with expanding and changing product and service offerings, industry standards, customer and market needs, new entrants and consolidations.
changes.new_quote: Competition could adversely impact our market share and financial results.
changes.summary: Language softened — removed 'may intensify' and added 'could adversely impact'.
